result.markdown:
If you’re looking for **plaintiff-side medical negligence lawyers in Sydney**—i.e., lawyers representing patients rather than doctors/hospitals—the strongest current options are concentrated in a handful of specialist practices.

I checked the **2026 Doyle’s Guide rankings**, which are particularly useful here because they specifically rank NSW medical-negligence lawyers based on peer nominations/interviews and input from defendant insurance lawyers. [doylesguide.com](https://doylesguide.com/rankings/medical-negligence-compensation-lawyers-plaintiff-new-south-wales/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### My Sydney shortlist

| Lawyer | Firm | 2026 Doyle’s ranking | Why consider them |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Libby Brookes** | Maurice Blackburn | **Preeminent** | One of the most consistently recognised medical-negligence lawyers in Sydney; also named **Best Lawyers 2026 Sydney Medical Negligence Lawyer of the Year**. [doylesguide.com](https://doylesguide.com/rankings/medical-negligence-compensation-lawyers-plaintiff-new-south-wales/?utm_source=chatgpt.com) |
| **Kate Henderson** | Beilby Poulden Costello (BPC) | **Preeminent** | Highly experienced in complex personal-injury and medical-negligence claims; a Law Society NSW Accredited Specialist in Personal Injury Law. [doylesguide.com](https://doylesguide.com/rankings/medical-negligence-compensation-lawyers-plaintiff-new-south-wales/?utm_source=chatgpt.com) |
| **Courtenay Poulden** | BPC | **Preeminent** | Longstanding specialist practice and repeatedly ranked at the top of NSW medical-negligence rankings. [doylesguide.com](https://doylesguide.com/rankings/medical-negligence-compensation-lawyers-plaintiff-new-south-wales/?utm_source=chatgpt.com) |

### If it were my case

I'd start by speaking with **3 lawyers rather than choosing purely from online reviews**:

1. **Libby Brookes / Maurice Blackburn** — particularly strong if the injury is serious or the claim is complex.
2. **Kate Henderson or Courtenay Poulden / BPC** — excellent choice for a specialist, high-end personal-injury practice.
3. **Kate Williams / Kate Williams Medical Law Specialists** — worth considering if you want a boutique practice whose focus is medical law.

The 2026 firm rankings broadly support that approach: **BPC and Carroll & O'Dea are First Tier**, while Burgan, Kate Williams Medical Law, Maurice Blackburn and Slater & Gordon are Second Tier. [doylesguide.com](https://doylesguide.com/rankings/medical-negligence-compensation-lawyers-plaintiff-new-south-wales/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[doylesguide.com](https://doylesguide.com/rankings/medical-negligence-compensation-law-firms-new-south-wales/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.turnerfreeman.com.au](https://www.turnerfreeman.com.au/personal-injury/medical-negligence/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

For a large national firm, **Slater & Gordon** also has dedicated Sydney medical-negligence teams and offices across Sydney. [www.slatergordon.com.au](https://www.slatergordon.com.au/personal-injury/medical-negligence-law/medical-negligence-lawyers-in-sydney?utm_source=chatgpt.com) **Turner Freeman** is another established option, although its 2026 Doyle's ranking is Third Tier rather than the top two tiers. [doylesguide.com](https://doylesguide.com/rankings/medical-negligence-compensation-lawyers-plaintiff-new-south-wales/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[doylesguide.com](https://doylesguide.com/rankings/medical-negligence-compensation-law-firms-new-south-wales/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.turnerfreeman.com.au](https://www.turnerfreeman.com.au/personal-injury/medical-negligence/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### One important point

Don't choose solely on the firm's headline "no win, no fee" offer. Medical-negligence cases can involve **expensive medical experts, causation disputes, limitation periods and potentially very substantial damages**, so the particular lawyer handling your matter matters enormously. The Law Society of NSW also maintains a solicitor register and allows you to identify Accredited Specialists. [www.lawsociety.com.au](https://www.lawsociety.com.au/register-solicitors/register-solicitors-search-help?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

If you tell me **what happened (e.g. misdiagnosis, surgical error, delayed cancer diagnosis, birth injury, cosmetic surgery, medication error, hospital negligence)** and roughly **when it happened**, I can narrow this to the **3 best Sydney lawyers for that particular type of claim**, including their recent case experience and contact details.

Medical-negligence cases can involve **expensive medical experts, causation disputes, limitation periods and potentially very substantial damages**, so the particular lawyer handling your matter matters enormously. The Law Society of NSW also maintains a solicitor register and allows you to identify Accredited Specialists. [www.lawsociety.com.au](https://www.lawsociety.com.au/register-solicitors/register-solicitors-search-help?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
